name: SnowWorld N.V.
summary: SnowWorld N.V. owns and operates indoor ski resorts. It also operates a hotel comprising 100 rooms and 420 beds; indoor skydive center; and winter sports specialist shops. The company operates in Landgraaf, Zoetermeer, Amsterdam, Rucphen, and Terneuzen, the Netherlands, as well as in Neuss in Germany. SnowWorld N.V. was founded in 1996 and is based in Zoetermeer, the Netherlands.
